title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00137 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 01:30: Continued r/u casing tong. Changed inserts in elevator. Meanwhile continued r/u chiksan hoses on WH. Performed TBT for m/u THRT
01:30 - 01:45: Prepared control line spool for THRT.
01:45 - 03:15: P/u and m/u THRT. Spaced out for BOP. Meanwhile contiued r/u hoses on WH.
03:15 - 03:30: M/u control lines to THRT.
03:30 - 04:00: RIH with THRT on 7" landing string to 19. 9m. Latched onto th. Pulled 10 ton overpull to confirm latch.
04:00 - 04:15: P/u and attempted to m/u 7" swedge. Too small od on swedge for casing tong to m/u. Meanwhile performed line test of hoses on WH.
04:15 - 04:30: P/u and m/u circulation swedge. Meanwhile continued line test on WH.
04:30 - 04:45: M/u cement hose and lo-torque valve.
04:45 - 05:15: Performed line-up test to circulatoin swedge. Pressure tested cement hose to 100 bar for 10 min.
05:15 - 06:00: Lined up to rig pumps. Pressured up DHSV control line to 520 bar. Pressured up tubing to 90 bar, indication of DHSV opened on control line pump. Bled off and monitored for pressure build-up in tubing for 5 min. No pressure build-up observed.
06:00 - 06:15: R/d cement hose and b/o circulation swedge.
06:15 - 06:30: Performed TBT for r/u WL
06:30 - 07:00: R/u wireline equipment.
07:00 - 08:00: R/u WL equipment. Observed crude oil dripping out of tubing while r/u WL, 0,5 ltrs/min. Installed swedge. Flowchecked well and monitored annulus gauge for 30 min, static. Meanwhile performed TBT for m/u cutter toolstring.
08:00 - 08:45: M/u cutter toolstring
08:45 - 10:15: RIH w/ cutter toolstring from surface to 2800 m.
10:15 - 10:45: Correlated depth and positioned cutter at 2774 mmd.
10:45 - 11:15: Pressure tested surface lines to 20/345 bar for 5/10 min.
11:15 - 11:30: Lined up to monitor pressure on annulus while performing cut. Cut tubing at 2774 mmd, good indications of cut, lost 280 lbs weight. No change in pressure observed on annulus.
11:30 - 13:00: POOH from 2774 m to surface.
13:00 - 13:15: L/d toolstring.

sections.text: Continued r/u casing tong. Changed inserts in elevator. Meanwhile continued r/u chiksan hoses on WH. Performed TBT for m/u THRT
Prepared control line spool for THRT.
P/u and m/u THRT. Spaced out for BOP. Meanwhile contiued r/u hoses on WH.
M/u control lines to THRT.
RIH with THRT on 7" landing string to 19. 9m. Latched onto th. Pulled 10 ton overpull to confirm latch.
P/u and attempted to m/u 7" swedge. Too small od on swedge for casing tong to m/u. Meanwhile performed line test of hoses on WH.
P/u and m/u circulation swedge. Meanwhile continued line test on WH.
M/u cement hose and lo-torque valve.
Performed line-up test to circulatoin swedge. Pressure tested cement hose to 100 bar for 10 min.

Lined up to rig pumps. Pressured up DHSV control line to 520 bar. Pressured up tubing to 90 bar, indication of DHSV opened on control line pump. Bled off and monitored for pressure build-up in tubing for 5 min. No pressure build-up observed.
R/d cement hose and b/o circulation swedge.
Performed TBT for r/u WL
R/u wireline equipment.

R/u WL equipment. Observed crude oil dripping out of tubing while r/u WL, 0,5 ltrs/min. Installed swedge. Flowchecked well and monitored annulus gauge for 30 min, static. Meanwhile performed TBT for m/u cutter toolstring.
M/u cutter toolstring
RIH w/ cutter toolstring from surface to 2800 m.
Correlated depth and positioned cutter at 2774 mmd.
Pressure tested surface lines to 20/345 bar for 5/10 min.
Lined up to monitor pressure on annulus while performing cut. Cut tubing at 2774 mmd, good indications of cut, lost 280 lbs weight. No change in pressure observed on annulus.
POOH from 2774 m to surface.
L/d toolstring.
R/d wireline equipment.
M/u swedge and installed cement hose. Lined up to circulate over poor boy degasser.
Performed TBT for handling h2s and gas on surface and pump room.
Circulated 2 x b/u down tubing and returns through choke via poor boy degasser, 1300 LPM 130 bar. MAX gas 6,2 1 ppm h2s in gas trap.
Flowchecked well, observed backflow out tubing 1 LPM. Backflow decreased and stopped. R/d swedge. Meanwhile performed TBT for releasing, pulling and l/d tubing hanger.
Released th. Attempted to pull th, 130 ton overpull. Worked string up/down several times.

Worked string up/down. MAX hookload 287 ton. Monitored well on TT, static. Nautral weight weight block weight) 158 ton. Strech measured from 158 ton to 287 ton, 6 cm. Estimated stuck point 55m. Most likely th stuck at 20m.
Performed TBT for investigating stuck tubing

Closed a-annulus valves and removed hose on annulus outlet. Opened valves, no backflow observed. P/u to 280 ton and slacked off to 67 ton, repeated 3 times. Noticed multibowl moving when picking up weight.
Evaluated situation. Discussed situation w/ onshore organisation. Meanwhile filled riser, monitored well on TT, static. Closed DHSV.
Rotated 8 turns right hand to release communication collar. Worked string up/down 157/67 ton hookload ton OP). THRT came free at 157 ton hookload.
POOH with THRT and l/d same.
Installed hoses on WH. Installed new pressure gauge on annulus outlet on WH. Meanwhile inspected diverter and drilling equipment after movement.
